已查到可引用的部分資料：

To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, we need formal R&S product specifications or features documents for our tester capabilities, not only battle-card positioning [18].  
We need formal CMX500 specifications for binding hardware and RF claims, because the CMX500 specifications document is the binding source for specifications, hardware unit models, order numbers, service and related product data [18].  
We need CMX500 Features and Functions evidence for signaling, WLAN, application, measurement and software-option claims, while noting that this document is a features overview and data without tolerance limits is not binding [18].  
For signaling claims, supported CMX500 evidence includes LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, XLAPI and SCPI remote control [15].  
For specific signaling options, supported evidence must cite option codes such as CMX-KS600B/M/X for NR signaling Rel. 15, CMX-KS617B/M/X for RedCap, CMX-KS627B/M/X for NTN Rel. 17, and CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS357B for WLAN signaling variants [17][19].  
For non-signaling or production claims, we need formal product-specific sources for each production platform, because the amarisoft comparison page states that CMP180, CMP200 and CMW100 K06 production-platform specifications must be cited separately [3].  
For CMP180 non-signaling / production positioning, supported evidence includes that CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing with configurable multi-port RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability [51].  
For CMP180 multi-port RF evidence, supported facts include RF generator/analyzer no. 1 with 8 × SnapN ports and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2 with 8 × SnapN ports requiring R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 [53].  
For CMP180 WLAN, NR, LTE, Bluetooth and other measurement claims, supported evidence must cite the listed CMP180 measurement options such as WLAN IEEE 802.11be SISO measurements R&S CMP-KM352, WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4 measurements R&S CMP-KM360, LTE measurements R&S CMP-KM500 and NR FR1 measurements R&S CMP-KM600 [56].  
We need competitor official datasheets, product brochures, configuration documents or third-party evidence for competitor capabilities, because the Anritsu comparison page says battle-card claims should be supplemented with Anritsu official data and third-party evidence for customer documents [10].  
We need the same kind of competitor official evidence for Keysight claims, because the Keysight battle-card page states its Keysight architecture, Wi-Fi, RedCap, FR3 / 6G and software-model claims lack Keysight official datasheets, versions, option/configuration documents or full specification conditions [33].  
We should not treat “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” “lower TCO” or similar sales-language statements as verified technical specifications [10].  
We also should not present R&S “industry’s only fully integrated platform,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability” or “lower TCO” claims as verifiable specifications unless they are traced to formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports or configuration tools [31].  
For conformance, operator-acceptance, PTCRB, GCF or pre-conformance comparisons, we need test package option codes, accreditation documents, validation reports or test-case lists, because the amarisoft comparison table says those items are not provided in the battle-card source [3].  
For TCO, calibration-count, licensing-cost or throughput-productivity comparisons, we need an explicit calculation or measured evidence, because the Anritsu offensive-play source states that fewer calibrations, fewer licenses, lower TCO and higher throughput are sales messages without a TCO formula [8].  
For software-workflow comparisons, we need source-level separation between R&S sales positioning and competitor official documentation, because Anritsu’s MX844030PC brochure supports integration with a common RTD GUI while the R&S battle card frames Anritsu software as fragmented [9].  
【推論】A supportable comparison package would therefore include R&S CMX500 specs/features for signaling, CMP180/CMP200/CMW100 K06 formal production or non-signaling documents for non-signaling, competitor official documents for the named competitor products, and separate conformance or TCO evidence where those claims are made [3][10][18][31][33].

answer.question: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | amarisoft positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公司與支援 | Global support、field engineering、calibration labs、service contracts、multi-year warranties | small French private company；remote-only support；no global footprint | [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 未引用第三方或 amarisoft 官方文件 |
| FR1 / FR2 | [[R&S CMX500]] covers FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz / calibrated FR2 | external RRH for FR2，calibration 以問號標示 | “up to 50 GHz” 為 battle card 說法；正式規格需引用 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] |
| Wi-Fi signaling | [[R&S CMX500]] integrated Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 | external AP/N3IWF 或 no Wi-Fi signaling | Wi-Fi feature 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance | PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests | functional only；not accepted for operator certification | 來源未列 test package option code 或 accreditation 文件 |
| Validated NTN | validated NR-NTN RF / RRM / protocol testcases，來源括註 w/ Samsung | functional simulation only | 未列 Samsung validation report 或 test case list |
| Legacy RAT | [[R&S CMW500]] 支援 2G/3G continuity | no 2G/3G stack | CMW500 正式能力需引用 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production / ATE / non-signaling path | no non-signaling platform、no production scaling path | 各 production platform 規格需分別引用其正式 source pages |
| Load / flexibility | battle card 主張 R&S validated testing | excellent functional load testing、up to 1000 UEs、flexible for NB-IoT / LTE-M / RedCap / basic NTN | amarisoft 能力缺少版本與硬體條件 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 Anritsu 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 提供 single integrated platform，涵蓋 FR1、FR2、FR3、fading、IP throughput、NTN、Wi-Fi、RF analysis 與 signaling；相對地，[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被描述為需要多 RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes、external PC / tools 與 fragmented software ecosystem。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + Fading + IP**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system，對比 Anritsu 的 MT8000A、MT8862A、IP Option 012 + external PC、external fading chambers 與 separate RF boards。
- **FR2 / FR3 performance leadership**：主張 R&S up to 50 GHz FR2、>16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth、>10 Gbps data rates 與 FR3 via RFU18；使用時需加註非正式規格限制。
- **Integrated WLAN signaling**：主張 R&S Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling directly inside CMX500，Anritsu 需 separate MT8862A。
- **R&D → Conformance → Production**：CMX500、CMW500、CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 構成 one vendor / one workflow / full lifecycle。
- **Future-proof technology**：Validated NTN、ORAN ORU / Conformance with partners、FR3 beyond 16 GHz、RedCap Rel-17/18。
- **Unified software ecosystem**：R&S Test Automation Suite 與 unified user experience；對比 Anritsu SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC。此項與 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 對 MX844030PC common RTD GUI 的說明並列保留，使用時需標明來源層次。
- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 與 Anritsu MX844030PC 官方 brochure 的關係
[[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）是 Anritsu 對 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 的 product brochure，確認 MX844030PC 為 **Virtual Signalling Tester NR Software**，支援 MAC-IF、PHY-IF Digital-IQ 與 RF-IF for RedCap，並使用 common [[RTD]] GUI 連接 Pre-silicon / Post-silicon protocol testing workflow。

⚠️ 來源 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10）說 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 使用 common [[RTD]] GUI，讓 NR protocol test cases 可在 Post-Silicon 與 Pre-silicon phase 間移植，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 說 Anritsu software 為 SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC 的 fragmented / disconnected tools。判斷：官方 brochure 支撐 MX844030PC 與 RTD 有整合面；battle card 的 fragmented 判斷仍可作為 R&S sales positioning，但不得當作 Anritsu 官方規格描述。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。

To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, we need formal R&S product specifications or features documents for our tester capabilities, not only battle-card positioning [18].  
We need formal CMX500 specifications for binding hardware and RF claims, because the CMX500 specifications document is the binding source for specifications, hardware unit models, order numbers, service and related product data [18].  
We need CMX500 Features and Functions evidence for signaling, WLAN, application, measurement and software-option claims, while noting that this document is a features overview and data without tolerance limits is not binding [18].  
For signaling claims, supported CMX500 evidence includes LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS / audio / POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, XLAPI and SCPI remote control [15].  
For specific signaling options, supported evidence must cite option codes such as CMX-KS600B/M/X for NR signaling Rel. 15, CMX-KS617B/M/X for RedCap, CMX-KS627B/M/X for NTN Rel. 17, and CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS357B for WLAN signaling variants [17][19].  
For non-signaling or production claims, we need formal product-specific sources for each production platform, because the amarisoft comparison page states that CMP180, CMP200 and CMW100 K06 production-platform specifications must be cited separately [3].  
For CMP180 non-signaling / production positioning, supported evidence includes that CMP180 is a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing with configurable multi-port RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability [51].  
For CMP180 multi-port RF evidence, supported facts include RF generator/analyzer no. 1 with 8 × SnapN ports and optional RF generator/analyzer no. 2 with 8 × SnapN ports requiring R&S CMP-K102 or R&S CMP-K105 [53].  
For CMP180 WLAN, NR, LTE, Bluetooth and other measurement claims, supported evidence must cite the listed CMP180 measurement options such as WLAN IEEE 802.11be SISO measurements R&S CMP-KM352, WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4 measurements R&S CMP-KM360, LTE measurements R&S CMP-KM500 and NR FR1 measurements R&S CMP-KM600 [56].  
We need competitor official datasheets, product brochures, configuration documents or third-party evidence for competitor capabilities, because the Anritsu comparison page says battle-card claims should be supplemented with Anritsu official data and third-party evidence for customer documents [10].  
We need the same kind of competitor official evidence for Keysight claims, because the Keysight battle-card page states its Keysight architecture, Wi-Fi, RedCap, FR3 / 6G and software-model claims lack Keysight official datasheets, versions, option/configuration documents or full specification conditions [33].  
We should not treat “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” “lower TCO” or similar sales-language statements as verified technical specifications [10].  
We also should not present R&S “industry’s only fully integrated platform,” “fully integrated,” “long-term scalability” or “lower TCO” claims as verifiable specifications unless they are traced to formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports or configuration tools [31].  
For conformance, operator-acceptance, PTCRB, GCF or pre-conformance comparisons, we need test package option codes, accreditation documents, validation reports or test-case lists, because the amarisoft comparison table says those items are not provided in the battle-card source [3].  
For TCO, calibration-count, licensing-cost or throughput-productivity comparisons, we need an explicit calculation or measured evidence, because the Anritsu offensive-play source states that fewer calibrations, fewer licenses, lower TCO and higher throughput are sales messages without a TCO formula [8].  
For software-workflow comparisons, we need source-level separation between R&S sales positioning and competitor official documentation, because Anritsu’s MX844030PC brochure supports integration with a common RTD GUI while the R&S battle card frames Anritsu software as fragmented [9].  
【推論】A supportable comparison package would therefore include R&S CMX500 specs/features for signaling, CMP180/CMP200/CMW100 K06 formal production or non-signaling documents for non-signaling, competitor official documents for the named competitor products, and separate conformance or TCO evidence where those claims are made [3][10][18][31][33].
